reviews.title: Wasn’t Working- Had to Buy Again
reviews.text: I have been using the app for about 10 years and it used to work great.  Past year it was unable to download data from the servers.  I had to purchase again which means it is not free of recurring costs.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: App crashes every time I try to download information

reviews.title: WAAAAAY off!
reviews.text: when I first got this app it worked pretty good. Now it’s about 60° off. Don’t waste your money get something else

reviews.title: Incomplete Offline Map Data
reviews.text: It is impossible to download all of the offline map data at once, even after checking iDevice storage and having the full amount of storage available. Why display the entire map if you cannot download it all to view on-demand?

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: Does not have correct names of mountains in NM

reviews.title: Peak Finder
reviews.text:
Have used this app for years and enjoyed it. 
Recently it’s just not picking up on any mountain range unless it’s very close. 

Pretty much useless  now even after updating the necessary local regional files.

reviews.title: Always 90° Off
reviews.text: I never used to have this problem, but like other reviews, it never orients itself and I’m often 90+ degrees off all the time. Super upsetting because it was great.
